takeaway: The radar's Nov 2 forecast, scored on 1,058 apps, reached a rank correlation of 0.84, its best yet. DeepSeek Harness disclosed 1.54 million daily users, making an open-source agent harness a mass-market product.

findings.heading: Best forecast yet: 0.84 across 1,058 apps
findings.text: The Nov 2 ranking's top 15 held 7 of the real top 15, where random picks would average about 0.2. It is the second forecast built mostly on the radar's own API measurements.

findings.heading: DeepSeek Harness: 1.54M daily users
findings.text: As of Nov 4, DeepSeek Harness had 1.54 million daily active users counted through DeepSeek's official API. Its main repo has 276,806 stars. Read from search results.

findings.heading: Meta's agent-ready design system jumps
findings.text: meta/astryx went from 14,770 to 17,654 stars in a day; Google's elephant-goldfish-model, a plugin for designing software with agents, gained 1,364.

findings.heading: Bad search terms now caught the day they fetch
findings.text: A new table shows what each automatic search term brought in. On day one it flagged three mostly off-topic terms, which are now dropped automatically.

caveats: From Nov 1 the scorecard compares hundreds or thousands of apps; read precision@15 against chance (15 divided by the apps compared).
The DeepSeek Harness user count comes from news reports of its disclosure, read in search results.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
